<h2>Run Common-Regularization sjSDM Sensitivity Models</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads prepared representative-model inputs, refits each model with a common
spatial regularization artifact, and returns decomposition and provenance.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_common_regularization_sensitivity(
  data_model_index = NULL,
  data_artifacts = NULL,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw,
  fit_function = NULL,
  standard_error_function = compute_jsdm_se,
  anova_function = compute_jsdm_variance_partition,
  extract_function = extract_jsdm_variance_fractions
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_model_index">data_model_index</code></td>
<td>
<p>Model index with model_id, tier_id, scale_id, resolution_id, and store_path.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_artifacts">data_artifacts</code></td>
<td>
<p>Common artifacts from [build_sjsdm_common_regularization_artifacts()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target reader. Defaults to [targets::tar_read_raw()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fit_function">fit_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable high-level model-fitting function. It receives prepared input,
formula, fitting configuration, and one regularization artifact.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="standard_error_function">standard_error_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable standard-error function. Defaults to [compute_jsdm_se()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="anova_function">anova_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable decomposition function. Defaults to
[compute_jsdm_variance_partition()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="extract_function">extract_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable ANOVA extractor. Defaults to
[extract_jsdm_variance_fractions()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing fitted models, ANOVA objects, model-level provenance,
and a long decomposition table. Individual failures are retained with an
explicit status and do not discard successful representative models.
</p>
